notable_absence.finding: This page has no Prerequisites/privilege section at all - it is a conceptual/feature page describing PARTITION BY HASH, not a statement grammar reference, so it does not repeat the Basic/Advanced credential-type privilege table that appears on the 9 statement pages in this batch.

cross_product_finding: This page contains an explicitly Capella-specific behavioral note that has no edition/version analogue in the server/ registry: 'In Couchbase Capella, max_parallelism is set by default to match the number of partitions of the index.' This is a deployment-specific default rather than an edition- or version-gated difference, and doesn't cleanly fit requiresEdition/availableSince/behavesDifferentlyUnder as currently scoped (those are edition- or version-keyed) - flagging rather than minting a relation for it, since a single sentence about a default value isn't clearly a 'clause/option within a statement' the way the promoted relations are scoped.
